work.text: Speaker catalog: CVP Engineering, GitHub Design and Microsoft CoreAI Design, Microsoft.

It's a bridging act Wired once summed up this way: "Maeda is to design what Warren Buffett is to finance." He currently leads design across GitHub and Microsoft CoreAI as Corporate Vice President of Engineering, and serves on the board of directors of MillerKnoll.

His path there runs through the MIT Media Lab, the presidency of the Rhode Island School of Design, a design partner role at Kleiner Perkins, and executive roles at Automattic, Publicis Sapient, and Everbridge.
